rejectedGenerations.reason: Correct Moxie identity and action sequence, but smooth purple backdrop leaked conspicuously into packed frames; rejected and superseded.

provenance.ballPolicy: The basketball remains a separate game object with its current carrier throughout this body-check action. Moxie never draws or visibly holds the ball in this animation.

review.reviewNotes: Eleven separate full-body Moxie poses are complete and row-major in a four-by-three sheet. Her pale human face, lavender eyes, long lavender high ponytail with gold tie, purple-silver uniform, wristbands and high-top shoes remain consistent. Pose5 depicts a controlled shoulder-to-chest bump with bent knees and open hands; poses recover to guard. The generated purple backdrop was removed with documented contrast matte; no backdrop haze remains in packed atlas. No ball or opponent appears.

provenance.cleanupNotes: The generated source contained a smooth, fully opaque purple backdrop despite the transparency request. The athlete-specific cleanup script removes low-frequency background color by multiplying source alpha by a local RGB-contrast matte (Gaussian sigma 38 px; 21–42 contrast fade). This leaves the detailed figure pixels and removes background haze. Raw generation preserved separately.

repack.fit: uniform scale, never upscale; max 86px high and cell width minus 10px; centered horizontally and baseline aligned with 5px bottom clearance
